$comment: SYNTHETIC template of a project glossary for check_terminology.py (hep-communication). Entries declare the concept, the preferred term per language (English and Traditional Chinese here), contextual aliases, the definition, abbreviations, the scope, and disallowed substitutions with the context words that make the substitution a likely confusion. Notation entries declare a symbol's definition per section scope so a legitimate local reuse is distinguishable from drift. Edit the values; every entry is an example.
